Anya (Marketing): thinking about a compact webinar to test audience propensity — panel (benchmarks + patterns) vs single-demo deep dive. which should we prioritize? :thinking_face:
Mike G.: panel would let us surface different POVs — good for PLG + enterprise leads. demo hits product folks harder.
Jordan R.: agree with Mike. can we AB test landing page CTA? panel = 'benchmark playbook', demo = 'hands-on cost/latency'
Anya (Marketing): yes. plan: 1) panel w/ 3 speakers 2) 20-min live demo as fallback in a second session. want to map lead routing for both CTAs. thoughts on speakers?
Leah - PR: ping folks who did benchmark blog. can we include an external customer? looks credible for press.
Mike G.: nominate Priya (infra), Carlos (cust success), and an external SRE from Acme Cloud. Priya can present latency knobs, Carlos can cover cost tradeoffs.
Jordan R.: agenda sketch (quick):
```
- 0:00 intro (5m)
- 5:00 benchmark narratives (15m) Priya
- 20:00 customer use cases (10m) Carlos + external
- 30:00 panel QA (15m)
- 45:00 short demo highlights + CTA (15m)
```
Anya (Marketing): love it. rehearsal suggestions: mandatory dry-run 48h before. ops to do a tech check 30m before.
ops-bot: calendar check: Found open slots for all proposed speakers: Thu 11:00 PT, Fri 16:00 GMT. Book rehearsal? <https://calendar.redwood.ai/rehearsals/1795554321> :white_check_mark:
Leah - PR: PR copy needed — one quote from exec, one from customer. Deadline: 3 business days before event.
Mike G.: lead-routing: we should send panel registrants to benchmark whitepaper + invite to request a Dedicated demo; demo registrants get a trial credit CTA. Separate GTM tags for hosted vs dedicated.
Jordan R.: also add an experiment param on the registration link: `?variant=panel` or `?variant=demo` so we can A/B conversion + downstream MQL quality.
Anya (Marketing): good — I'll draft 2 landing pages and set up the reg params. Can someone volunteer to own speaker slide deck consolidation?
Mike G.: I can consolidate, will create a shared deck and an outline by EOD tomorrow.
Leah - PR: I'll coordinate press materials and send suggested quotes to speakers by Tue.
Anya (Marketing): rehearsal checklist to confirm in dry-run:
- mics/headset check
- screen-sharing + demo VM access
- intro slide + speaker order
- backup video recording + fallback (pre-recorded demo)
- CTAs + registration link verified

Anya (Marketing): final ask: please reply with availability for Thu 11:00 PT rehearsal. if no reply by EOD today I'll book Thu and assume yes. :calendar:
